Official MoSPI API responses, retrieved October 2026.

`official_2022_23_history.json` contains the complete 41-month General IIP history, April 2023–August 2026, retrieved 5 October 2026 from https://api.mospi.gov.in/api/iip/getIIPData?frequency=Monthly&base_year=2022-23&type=General&limit=100&page=1&Format=JSON . Use the published `growth_rate`, never the index level. No overlap agreement with the legacy manual series is required. The older partial/base fixtures remain for diagnostic regression checks.
